entry.title: [Magick.NET-Q8-x86] ImageMagick has out-of-bounds write in ICON decoder due to incorrect loop
entry.content:
An incorrect loop in the ICON decoder can result in an out of bounds heap write resulting in a crash.

References

  • https://github.com/ImageMagick/ImageMagick/security/advisories/GHSA-g22q-f7gc-5jhr
  • https://nvd.nist.gov/vuln/detail/CVE-2026-53461
  • https://github.com/advisories/GHSA-g22q-f7gc-5jhr

entry.title: [Magick.NET-Q8-x86] ImageMagick: Policy Bypass can Trigger an Out-of-Memory condition
entry.content:
A missing check for maximum memory request in AcquireAlignedMemory could trigger an out-of-Memory condition.

Credit

Aisle Research (Ze Sheng, Dmitrijs Trizna, Luigino Camastra, Guido Vranken)

References

  • https://github.com/ImageMagick/ImageMagick/security/advisories/GHSA-q62c-h75r-2xhc
  • https://nvd.nist.gov/vuln/detail/CVE-2026-53460
  • https://github.com/dlemstra/Magick.NET/releases/tag/14.14.0
  • https://github.com/advisories/GHSA-q62c-h75r-2xhc
